metadata.title: Minimalist High-Key Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, minimalist composition featuring a desaturated, grainy portrait of a person lying down, positioned in the lower-left quadrant. The subject is surrounded by expansive white negative space, with a small cluster of black typography anchored in the bottom-right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned diagonally against a vast white void
High-contrast black text balancing the dark tones of the subject's hair
Grainy film texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is cropped and placed in the lower-left corner, occupying approximately 25% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark hair and facial features of the subject provide the primary weight, balanced by the text in the opposite corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the diagonal line of the body, and rests on the typography in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant, occupying roughly 70% of the canvas to create a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background providing a high-key environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the subject's hair and the typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle, desaturated skin tones and a faint hint of color on the clothing graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high value (brightness) with very low saturation, creating a near-monochrome effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a casual, fluid script and a clean, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Continuous stroke, medium weight, upright posture with natural ligatures.
Sans-serif: All-caps, even stroke weight, wide tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'R' features a prominent, rounded loop and a long tail.
Sans-serif 'E' and 'A' have open, geometric proportions.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fluid handwriting and rigid, geometric industrial type.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom line

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary fluid, upright script feel.
Offers the clean, geometric all-caps look for the metadata line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-key, grainy photograph of a person with dark hair lying down on a white surface, positioned in the lower-left corner. The image should be mostly white negative space with high contrast and low saturation.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of black text in the bottom-right corner. The top line should be a large, upright script font. The bottom line should be a small, bold, all-caps geometric sans-serif font with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text right-aligned in the bottom corner?
Is there a visible film grain texture across the entire image?
Does the script font appear fluid and handwritten?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject does not dominate the frame.
Check that the script and sans-serif fonts do not touch.
Verify the grain is uniform and not blotchy.
Confirm the white space feels intentional and not empty.
recipe.reuseFormula: Position a desaturated subject in one corner + Fill 70% of the frame with white + Anchor right-aligned contrasting typography in the opposite corner + Apply global film grain.
